provenance.notes: Recorded, verified Foundry execution at aa01b168. The tool activity timeline is measured, but this is not a live Azure Monitor feed.

agents.name: Data Architect
agents.summary: Audits source anomalies, control-row semantics, data assumptions and proposed policy decisions.
agents.boundary: No source changes. Findings must cite evidence.

agents.name: Data Engineer
agents.summary: Checks the actual Python implementation against the task, contract and tests.
agents.boundary: Read-only reviewer, not an autonomous code author.

agents.name: Verification Engineer
agents.summary: Attempts to falsify correctness using independent arithmetic, test outputs and provenance.
agents.boundary: Cannot alter the code under review or approve it by assertion.

checkpoints.title: Source integrity
checkpoints.description: Raw CSV and control row are read before cleaning; source quantity and discount totals reconcile.

checkpoints.title: Policy boundary
checkpoints.description: Versioned, allowlisted DataPolicy rejects unknown repair strategies before output is written.

checkpoints.title: Deterministic ETL
checkpoints.description: pandas transformations and Decimal arithmetic generate the final regional revenue file.

checkpoints.title: Independent verification
checkpoints.description: Supplied tests, Hypothesis, regression tests and a raw-CSV Decimal oracle execute in CI.

checkpoints.title: Federated identity
checkpoints.description: GitHub Actions exchanges short-lived OIDC credentials to run a scoped Foundry review.

checkpoints.title: Three-agent review
checkpoints.description: Three role-specific LLM reports are parsed using strict Pydantic schemas.

checkpoints.title: Evidence gate
checkpoints.description: Hashes of source, policy, output, code and tests must match the reviewed commit.

decisions.title: Duplicate rows are a business decision
decisions.observation: The raw source contains five additional identical rows; its TOTAL row agrees with the raw export including those rows.
decisions.decision: Remove source-exact duplicate rows after validating raw controls.
decisions.risk: The export does not independently prove that two identical lines are accidental rather than separate business events.
decisions.verification: Independent raw-CSV oracle; raw and clean count assertions.

decisions.title: Recover missing unit prices conservatively
decisions.observation: Four rows have no unit price.
decisions.decision: Fill a missing price only when all normalized prices for that product agree; otherwise reject the dataset.
decisions.risk: A single observed product price does not prove historical price correctness.
decisions.verification: Ambiguity tests and product-price uniqueness assertion.

decisions.title: Retain negative quantities
decisions.observation: Six transaction rows have negative quantities.
decisions.decision: Preserve signed quantities as returns/credits in revenue.
decisions.risk: The source has no explicit return flag; the business meaning is not proven.
decisions.verification: Signed Decimal revenue checks and independent oracle.

decisions.title: Reject unapproved normalization
decisions.observation: Blanket trimming could silently modify identifiers, product labels or financial fields.
decisions.decision: Normalize region labels only where the policy allows it; reject malformed non-region values.
decisions.risk: Convenient coercions can collapse distinct source records or hide defects.
decisions.verification: Five fail-closed whitespace tests and strict-region regressions.

decisions.title: Protect source and policy artifacts
decisions.observation: An output path alias could overwrite a source CSV or approved policy file.
decisions.decision: Reject path collisions before any writes; hash source and policy before generating output.
decisions.risk: Incorrect runtime path configuration may destroy original evidence.
decisions.verification: Three collision regression tests against unchanged input bytes.

cases.title: When five identical rows are not a simple delete
cases.subtitle: An agent surfaced a bug hidden behind a green test suite.
cases.discovery: Duplicate detection was performed after normalization, so distinct raw records could collapse into the same key.
cases.counterexample: A row with permitted region whitespace must not be deduplicated merely because it normalizes to an existing row.
cases.change: Compare raw row values before cleaning; enforce strict regions; validate structural control rows.
cases.proof: Regression tests added; independent CSV/Decimal oracle; green CI on both operating systems.

cases.title: A normalization rule should not silently rewrite the source
cases.subtitle: Correct arithmetic is not enough when data meaning changes.
cases.discovery: A global .strip() was applied to every string field, not only the region field explicitly authorized by the policy.
cases.counterexample: Leading/trailing whitespace in an order ID or unit price is rejected instead of silently repaired.
cases.change: Field-scoped validation replaces blanket coercion, and the source TOTAL is independently recomputed.
cases.proof: Five additional fail-closed tests, source-control oracle, Windows + Ubuntu CI.

cases.title: The pipeline must never overwrite its own evidence
cases.subtitle: From a review finding to a tested I/O safety boundary.
cases.discovery: Output paths were not prevented from matching the source, approved policy or report paths.
cases.counterexample: A pipeline with output=source must fail before the first write and leave source bytes unchanged.
cases.change: Resolve and compare all artifact paths, fail on collisions and hash source inputs before output publication.
cases.proof: Three path-collision tests, preserved source bytes and green cross-platform CI.
